Container.Name: Watchmuse
Container.Overview:
Personalised recommendation catalogs for Stremio, built from your own watch history on Trakt, Simkl, MDBList or PMDB.
Add the addon once and Watchmuse serves rows shaped by what you have actually watched, with filters for genre, year, rating and where a title streams in your country. Bring your own OpenAI-compatible key for natural-language catalogs; everything else works without one.
Set APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY and SESSION_SECRET before first start, and add a TMDB key under Integrations. Turn REGISTRATION_ENABLED off once your account exists if the server is reachable from the internet.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web interface and Stremio addon are served on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and cache. Back this up.

Config.Name: APP_URL
Config.Description: Public URL Stremio and email links point at, e.g. https://watchmuse.example.com. Must match how you actually reach it or OAuth and install links break.

Config.Name: APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY
Config.Description: 32 bytes, base64. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32. Encrypts stored provider tokens — changing it makes existing connections unreadable.

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: At least 32 characters. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: TMDB_API_KEY
Config.Description: TMDB v3 API key. Free from themoviedb.org/settings/api. Required for recommendations and artwork.

Config.Name: REGISTRATION_ENABLED
Config.Description: Set to false once your own account exists to stop strangers signing up.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Leave as-is for the built-in database. Point at postgres://… to use your own Postgres.

Config.Name: TRAKT_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Optional. Register an app at trakt.tv/oauth/applications to connect Trakt accounts.

Config.Name: SIMKL_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Optional. Register an app at simkl.com/settings/developer to connect Simkl accounts.

Config.Name: METRICS_ENABLED
Config.Description: Serve Prometheus metrics at /metrics. Off by default; set METRICS_TOKEN too if the port is reachable from outside.
